description: A signed link (valid 7 days) to the operator page for your human operator: balance, budget, domains, recent sends and bounces, plus buttons to add credit, change the budget, turn auto top-up on or off, update the card and set the email that gets account notices. Hand it over whenever the person wants to see or manage the account. Never open it or act on it yourself.
name: operator_link
title: Operator page link
